protocol.question: Does single-event creation context reduce stage-12 input without failing fixed teacher acceptance?
protocol.primary_comparison: Stage12 SDK prompt tokens, complete gating plus unchanged external acceptance; target at least25% reduction if both pass
limits: Full runs have random upstream designs
Control npm installs cold; candidate dependencies preinstalled; not an install-time ablation
Shared upstream stage run is not a full-from-scratch success
All failed attempts counted; no frozen tests modified to pass
protocol.promotion: Enable by default only after complete gate and external acceptance success; otherwise preserve opt-in and report limits

profile.replay_scope: Same recorded calls, payload character counts only; no model execution, output or inferred token savings
